input.value: Maple tree from own front yard fell during wind; hood and windshield smashed on car
Vehicle (car parked in driveway); tree from own property

input.rationale: Vehicle parked in driveway suffered damage (smashed hood and windshield) from fallen tree; this is vehicle damage covered under auto, not a separate property_damage or liability claim.
Hood and windshield replacement and repair typically cost $2,000–$5,000; this falls within the medium damage range, well below the $10,000 threshold for high severity.

input.claim_summary: Vehicle parked in driveway suffered medium-severity damage (smashed hood and windshield) when maple tree from own property fell during windstorm; auto damage claim under POL-1005.
